items.title: Update to ArcGIS Pro Product Life Cycle
items.summary: Beginning with the release of ArcGIS Pro 3.8 (November 2026), we are updating the ArcGIS Pro product life cycle (PLC) to make software support easier to understand, simplify upgrade planning, and improve alignment with the ArcGIS Enterprise life cycle.

items.title: How the GNIS Lake Ontario/Lake America name change in the U.S. will appear in Maps
items.summary: The U.S. Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) has formally changed the name for "Lake Ontario" to "Lake America" in the United States.

items.title: Daybreak for Frontline Defenders: $1B to protect essential services
items.summary: OpenAI is committing $1 billion in subsidized Daybreak access, training, technical support, and partnerships to help frontline defenders protect essential services.

items.title: Legora reviewed 41 documents in minutes with GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: Legora uses Astra to improve accuracy, completeness, and reliability, while keeping final judgment with legal professionals.

items.title: Playco cut manual fixes 50% prototyping games with GPT-6 Astra
items.summary: Using GPT‑6 Astra, Playco built three themed game prototypes from one grey box foundation, with most working on the first take.

items.title: Data from drones in Ukraine is fueling a new Wild West marketplace
items.summary: Battlefields in Ukraine are littered with the remnants of drones, which are now firmly established as a critical weapon of modern warfare.

items.title: Introducing WeatherNext 3, our most advanced and accurate global weather AI model
items.summary: Our flagship AI weather forecasting model now includes real-time satellite data, hourly refreshes, higher resolution, precise precipitation forecasting, and clean energy variables.

items.title: Lawmakers behind the strictest state AI laws urge tech companies to slow down
items.summary: DEVELOPING: Judge gives Lindsay Clancy’s defense an hour to appeal his plan to declare a mistrial The architects of the country’s strongest state AI laws are calling on the largest AI companies to rein in the speed of AI development until their safety-focused efforts can match their technological advances.
